submitted.rationale: Index 15 (La0.67Sb0.33) had the highest EQE of the three measured compositions: 0.0025%. The other two were at or below zero. At this composition MEGNet predicts a 2.6 eV gap for the La2SbO6-type phase, which the 3.2 eV photons can excite. XRD at this composition showed mostly weak, poorly crystalline features.

rejected.reason: EQE of -0.0009%, effectively zero, even though stable La3Sb5O12 was predicted to have a 2.26 eV gap
EQE of -0.0003%, effectively zero; this region is dominated by La3SbO7, which is on the hull with a 4.3 eV gap

consultations.verdict: Support: La3Sb5O12 (Sb 0.625) is on the MACE hull and has a MEGNet HSE gap of 2.26 eV, which is below the 3.2 eV photon energy. The La-rich phases La3SbO7 and LaSbO4 have gaps above 4.3 eV and cannot absorb. Index 25 (Sb 0.618) is the closest match to the La3Sb5O12 composition.

Weak support only. La2O3 has a 5.5 eV gap, so the La-rich end should not absorb. The La2SbO6-like composition near Sb 0.33 was predicted at 2.6 eV (metastable, 0.085 eV above hull), which is within reach of the 3.2 eV photons. Index 25 gave roughly zero EQE, so this tests the middle of the composition line.

Mildly against, but not decisive. La3SbO7 (Sb 0.25) is on the hull with a 4.3 eV gap, so a transparent phase is likely near index 11. However, the measured EQE rises toward the La side (index 15 > index 25), and in-gap defect absorption in thin films can still contribute. The GP-UCB points to index 11, and I am using the last measurement to explore there.
